Reference renders of the launch splash (v5 mark drawing on), in the current tokens: `cofferdam-splash-preview.mp4` (light) and `cofferdam-splash-preview-dark.mp4` (dark, the lifted navy ground), 390×844 at 30 fps, and `preview-keyframes.png` (eight moments from the native splash to the app, light row over dark). The animation itself is code in the repository's `motion/splash/`. Re-render with `python3 scripts/render-previews.py` after a mark or splash token changes; the designer's originals are in `motion/splash/original-renders/`.
